model: Scroll Chiller / Heat Pump / Condensing Unit (SC-EQ)
equipment_type: Scroll chiller / heat pump / condensing unit (via SC-EQ card)
applies_to: YORK by Johnson Controls scroll-compressor chillers, heat pumps and condensing units (one or two refrigerant systems, including the YCWL) fitted with the SC-EQ communication card.
summary: This SC-EQ list covers the YORK scroll product family: air- and water-cooled scroll chillers, heat pumps and condensing units. The SC-EQ card serves BACnet MS/TP (or Modbus RTU / N2). The BAS can start/stop the unit or each system, write setpoints, range, load limit stage and heat pump mode. Several objects change meaning with the unit type (condensing unit, heat pump, YCWL, EEV, refrigerant), so the sheet prints more than one row for them.
notes: Access is inferred: the sheet has no read/write column. The remote block (AV 1-4, BV 1, BV 2, BV 4) is treated as commandable; everything else as read-only.

AV 1, AV 3, AV 8, AV 15, AV 24, AV 36-39, BV 1, BV 11 and BV 15 have two or three printed rows that depend on unit type (condensing unit with suction pressure control, heat pump, YCWL, refrigerant). They are merged into one row each with all names.
System 2 points only report on two-system units; EEV, heat pump and condensing unit points only on those units.

Operational and fault code MVs (MV 1-4) are the printed code + 1, as the sheet says to add 1 for BACnet MSV values; the AV copies (AV 501-504) carry the raw code. MV 10 / AV 505 are shown as printed, from 0; the card may report the printed number + 1.
This list has no MV 65001 Units object. Units shown are the IP units. Spare objects are left out.

integration.summary: Put the unit in remote control (BV 21 reads Remote), then start/stop it with BV 1 and write the remote setpoint (AV 1) and, if needed, the load limit stage (AV 2). Read the leaving chilled liquid temperature, compressor run status, the per-system alarms (BV 5, BV 6) and the per-system operational and fault codes.

minimum_points.name: REM START STOP CMD / SYS1 REM START STOP CMD
LOCAL REMOTE CONTROL MODE
minimum_points.why: Must read Remote (1) for BMS control

integration.enable: BV 21 shows Local or Remote control mode. The points list gives no point to change it and no write-enable point. AV 4 selects panel, cool or heat on heat pump units.
setup: The BAS connects to the SC-EQ J12 port (RS-485: +, -, COM/REF, SHLD). The card detects BACnet MS/TP, Modbus RTU or N2 and the baud rate by itself; allow up to 120 seconds after power-up.
The MAC address (1-127) is set on DIP switch SW1 (switch 8 unused). Cycle the card's power after changing it.

The device instance defaults to 5000 + the MAC address (MAC 6 gives 5006). To use another number, set Device Instance Mode to Manual and enter the instance with the SC-AP / MAP tool, or write BV 65000 (mode) and AV 65000 (instance ID).
gotchas: The remote (commandable) setpoints read as unreliable until the BAS writes them the first time.
The SC-EQ only exposes the points that apply to the chiller it detects; if it replaces an E-Link, re-discover the device so old non-applicable points don't sit offline.
Check the unit type before mapping: AV 1, AV 3 and AV 36-39 mean different things on suction-pressure condensing units, heat pumps and chillers.
